summary.prose: The build adds one new module, a file-backed chat session store with a one-time migration out of VS Code's globalState, and switches the extension to it. It goes in six steps: export the old store's keys and checks, build the file store's core, add its rules for several windows, eviction and failing writes, add the migration, wire it into the extension, then prove it over the real file system and the chat panel. The panel and the turn lifecycle are not edited. The last step includes a check on the user's own machine, because the real migration cannot be run by the gate.

Correct the file header ('no local-JSON file') and the ChatSession.liveTurn comment ('Sessions live in globalState') to say sessions are kept in files under ~/.insrc/chat-sessions. No behaviour changes.

tasks.title: File seam and the file store's core: files, read, list and appending save
tasks.summary: New vscode-plugin/src/chat/session-file-store.ts: the SessionFilesFs interface with nodeSessionFilesFs, and createFileChatSessionStore implementing ChatSessionStore over `<root>/<sessionFileName(id)>.head.json` and `.rows.ndjson`. Per-object tracking of the rows on disk; save appends the rows beyond the object's count and replaces the head through a temporary file and a rename, head after rows; draft writes nothing and create saves at once; get reads once and returns the same object while the files are unchanged; list reads heads only; a damaged head reads as absent; a torn last rows line is dropped and cut back, a bad middle line skipped; an id is stored under sessionFileName(id) and read back with its real id. Includes the in-memory recording fake used by the tests.

tasks.title: Several windows, whole-file writes, failing writes and the session cap
tasks.summary: Complete the store's save rules. Per id, record the rows file's size as the store last left or read it, including after its own cut-back of a torn last line. When the file has grown, another writer appended: still append this object's new rows, keep the object tracked, drop only the id's cached object so the next get reads the files. Write the rows file whole (temporary file and rename) in exactly three cases: an object never tracked for an id whose files exist; a tracked object whose transcript is shorter than its count; and (review finding accepted by override) a tracked object whose rows file is missing or smaller than the recorded size, or whose head is gone, as after an eviction, so the session comes back complete. That last save counts as creating a new head, so the cap is applied. A failing append or head write throws and leaves the count where the rows on disk are. With maxSessions, a save that creates a new head removes the oldest heads by savedAt with their rows files and calls onEvict, never the session being saved; a failing remove is logged.
acceptanceChecks: After another writer appended, the same held object saved three times (new row, head change only, after a get of its id) only ever appends; the rows file is never replaced and holds both writers' rows in save order; the get returns a fresh object with all of them
A held object saved after its files were removed (evicted) writes its whole transcript and its head, get then returns every row, and the cap is applied without removing it
A save after the store cut back a torn last line appends and does not replace the rows file
A never-tracked object saved for an id whose files exist, and a tracked object whose transcript is shorter than its count, each replace the rows file whole through a temporary file and a rename
A failing append or head write makes save throw; the next save writes the missing rows once and none twice

With maxSessions set, a save that creates a new session removes the oldest sessions' files and calls onEvict for each, never the one being saved; a failing remove is logged and the save succeeds; a cap of 0 or less is no cap

tasks.title: Migrate sessions out of globalState
tasks.summary: In session-file-store.ts add migrateChatSessionsFromMemento: for each indexed session isSession accepts, write its files when no head exists (rows then head, through temporary files), append the missing rows when the files hold a prefix, write nothing when the memento holds a prefix of the files; read the files back and compare every row and head field; remove the memento key only then. A session that fails, disagrees or is rejected is left untouched, logged and returned in kept. Rewrite or remove the index. Never throws.
acceptanceChecks: Each indexed session is written, read back equal, and only then removed from the memento with the index; the file store then lists and returns every session as the memento store did
A session whose write or read-back fails is left in the memento untouched, stays in the index and is in kept, and the others are still migrated

Files holding a prefix of the memento's rows get the missing rows and the key is removed; files holding more rows are left and the key removed; a disagreeing session is changed in neither place and is in kept
With no index, or on a second run, nothing is read or written and kept is empty; an entry isSession rejects is kept and logged

tests.name: the migration writes each indexed session's files, reads them back equal, then removes its memento key and the index; the store then lists and returns every session as the memento store did
a session whose write or read-back fails is left in the memento untouched, stays in the index and is returned in kept, and the others are still migrated

a session whose files already hold a prefix of the memento's rows gets the missing rows appended and its memento key removed; one whose files hold more rows than the memento is left as it is on disk and its key removed; one that disagrees is changed in neither place and returned in kept
the migration with no index, or run a second time, reads no session, writes nothing and returns no kept id; an entry isSession rejects is kept and logged

tasks.title: Wire the file store into the extension
tasks.summary: In extension.ts run migrateChatSessionsFromMemento over context.globalState first, build chatStore with createFileChatSessionStore over join(PATHS.insrc, 'chat-sessions') with the same maxSessions and onEvict, and give the output sweep a keep set of the store's ids plus the migration's kept ids. Update extension-chat-wiring.test.ts: replace the line-46 assertion with ones for the file store, its root and the migration placed before it; keep the onEvict assertion; change the sweep assertion to the new keep set.
acceptanceChecks: extension.ts calls the migration before it builds the file store over join(PATHS.insrc, 'chat-sessions') with the session cap and the onEvict
The sweep's keep set holds the store's ids and the migration's kept ids
createMementoChatSessionStore is no longer constructed in extension.ts
The plugin type-checks and the wiring test passes with the updated assertions

tasks.title: Integration tests over the real file system and the chat panel, and the real migration
tasks.summary: Tests, plus one reported check. Over a real temporary directory, two store instances on one session each append, the first saves its held object twice more with a get between, and a hand-written torn last line is dropped and cut back. The chat panel run over the file store: a turn's saves append only that turn's rows, a restored session shows the same rows, and a failing save is logged without breaking the turn. A session the migration kept in globalState keeps its output files through the start-up sweep. Any defect these expose in the code of t2 to t5 is fixed here. Last, the builder installs the build and reports what the real migration did on the user's machine; the gate cannot run that, so it is recorded as reported.
